correctness.rationale: The translation action T_a on the odd cyclic dihedral quandle algebra is a finite-order algebra automorphism and semisimple after extending to a splitting field when char K does not divide n. At translation weight t≠0 the coefficient Leibniz equation is a quadratic vanishing on at least three distinct powers of a root of unity, forcing zero. The remaining circulant coefficients satisfy c_u=c_-u+c_(u/2), equivalently antisymmetry plus c_(2u)=c_u/2; one free parameter exists on each signed-doubling orbit exactly when p divides Delta_m. The number of such orbits of additive order m is phi(m)/|<2,-1>|. This proves the dimension formula and commutative Lie bracket for all allowed n, not merely tested small cases. Finite n=11,p=3 and n=13,p=5 multiplicative orders and the independently inspected unrestricted linear checker support the proof.
